'''X-6''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Target" /> [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who, along with six other men, was hired to participate in [[Project Omega]]. The project was an experiment by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] to create the perfect assassin, who would then go on to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After Soresh wiped the participants' identities from a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] database system and had their faces surgically altered, he started his brutal reconditioning program, which was designed to turn them into mindless servants by removing their past memories and emotions.<ref name="Trapped">''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]''</ref>

At first, X-6 became friends with [[X-1 (assassin)|X-1]], [[X-2]], [[X-3]], [[X-4]], [[X-5]] and [[X-7]], the other participants in the training program. Nevertheless, after Soresh started torturing them with [[Torture/Legends|electrocution]], X-6, like his fellows, had their personality and [[Brain/Legends|mind]] changed completely until they felt no emotions.<ref name="Target" /> Around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the assassins-in-training were all pitted against each other until only one remained. X-7 easily [[Death/Legends|killed]] X-6 and earned the right to become Soresh's personal assassin.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
X-6 first appeared in a flashback sequence in ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first book of the young readers series ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'', published in [[2008]] and written by [[Alex Wheeler]].<ref name="Target" />
